$Comment: First in the Dew Reaper's right click, before the slow swing. Refuses the click (chain failed, so no swing, no hum, no power spent; a chat message if ShowMessages) when Water of Arrakis is missing or there are fewer than PowerCost power. Otherwise pays PowerCost, starts the hum and remembers the mode: PrimroseBlockId under the crosshair (within Range) = Primrose mode (PrimroseWater units), anything else = air mode (AirWaterUnits). Arrakis_Dew_Reaper_Finish does the work after the swing: the units go into the first Litrejon with room (never into the player's own water); with none, they are lost and a message says so.
